dct_description_sm: OneSoil employs a proprietary machine learning (ML) model based on state-of-the-art instance segmentation to detect field boundaries. Utilizing raw Sentinel-2 data aggregated according to local vegetation season maps and an additional upscaling module to enhance boundary accuracy, we ensure precise results. OneSoil’s data preprocessing involves the utilization of their cloud detector module and local season mapping.
dct_title_s: Automatically Detected Field Boundaries in Canada, 2023
